A little help

Write to hi@hackmamba.io for help with Mural.

For a bug report, include your phone model, operating system version, learning language and what happened. Please leave API keys and private conversation content out of screenshots.

Email support ↗Report an issue

Delete your Mural account

To request deletion of your Mural account and its associated account data, email hi@hackmamba.io with the subject “Mural account deletion request”. You can use this path without installing or signing in to the app.

Request account deletion ↗

The button prepares an email draft. Send it to submit your request. If no email app opens, copy hi@hackmamba.io into your preferred email service.

Send the request from the email address you use for Mural. If you no longer have access to it, explain that in your message so we can arrange another way to verify ownership. Please do not send passwords, API keys, payment credentials or conversation exports.

Support will verify ownership and review any remaining balance, active conversation or payment awaiting confirmation. We will explain any steps needed to complete the deletion. Submitting a request does not itself cancel a purchase, issue a refund or forfeit paid value.

When deletion is completed, we remove your identifying account profile, sign-in provider links and Mural sign-in sessions. We may retain limited billing, usage and trial-eligibility records where needed for financial obligations, fraud prevention or disputes. These retained records use an opaque account reference. Support correspondence and protected backups follow the retention practices in our privacy policy.

Your learning history and saved API key stay on your device. Use Settings in Mural to export or delete learning data and remove your API key. Deleting Mural does not delete your Google or Apple account.

You can also open Settings → Your account → Delete account in Mural. If automatic deletion cannot finish, use the support route above.
